# Contributing

Bug reports and feature requests are welcome — please [open an issue](https://github.com/tadis174/ILens/issues/new). When reporting a bug, it helps to mention the ILens version (`ILens.exe --version`), your OS, and the MCP tool call that produced the problem.

## Pull requests

This project does not accept pull requests. Any PR opened against this repository is closed automatically with a polite comment redirecting to the issue tracker. If you have a fix or change in mind, please describe it in an issue and I'll take a look.
